args.body: Read Layer5 CONTRIBUTING and issue 8294 comments: maintainers explicitly assigned the repair to another contributor, and CONTRIBUTING says to start only after assignment. Reject this candidate; do not prepare its patch or request assignment. Kubespray 12104 also has existing assignees; Qubes 904 concerns anti-forensics rather than documentation repair, Qubes 1019 requests offline documentation architecture, and HertzBeat 3166 requests new feature documentation rather than a bounded broken-link repair. Finish the five-candidate verdict from exact evidence; inspect remaining comments only where needed to resolve suitability. Save and read a concise rejection artifact, then complete DOCS-REQUEST-FULFILLMENT with the actual lease and a lesson. No more generic samples, broad scans, external posting or credential probes. Help-wanted requests do not establish willingness to pay.

description: Layer5's repair is explicitly assigned to another contributor and its rules require assignment before work. Reject that candidate; finish the bounded request experiment without inventing paid demand or revenue.
